title: Sneaky Picking
description: Only allow picking up items from click or sneaking. It's actually keybind configurable.
body:
# Sneaky Picking
Sneaky Picking changes vanilla item pickup behavior by replacing it with two keybinds to pick up items.

![Keybinds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/329ba246a8c05436856b4f4414c5ed16e827c978.png)

Right Click - Pick up item targeted by crosshair/have the item HUD visible

Left Shift - Pick up nearby items. Regular Minecraft pickup behavior

![Item Pickups](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gCXt6o4i/images/72c7bbdf0021183cb74a7b94f255257a349e469e.gif) ![Sneaky Picking](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gCXt6o4i/images/d85e95dc37b64950ad58219a4e9b597e6973a1bf.gif)

#### Item pick up interaction (Pick Up Targeted Item) range is dependent on the player's `minecraft:entity_interaction_range` attribute.
